about_short_description.short_description: FollowUpThen is a tool to schedule automatic email followups.

product.name: FollowUpThen Email Reminder Service
product.description: An email-based tool that schedules automatic follow-up reminders by sending emails to a special address with a date before the @ sign.

product.name: FollowUpThen Web Application
product.description: A web app for viewing, managing, and interacting with upcoming follow-ups and reminders scheduled through FollowUpThen.

product.name: FollowUpThen Skills Add-Ons
product.description: Optional add-ons that extend FollowUpThen’s functionality with features like SMS notifications, response detection, calendar integration, and recurring reminders.

product.name: FollowUpThen Team Plans
product.description: Subscription plans designed for teams that include features like centralized billing, team data ownership, and individual skill budgets per member.

product.name: Email-Based Actions
product.description: A premium feature that allows users to interact with their follow-ups directly from their email client without leaving the inbox.
